text:
sasha: kicking off a private canary for Magna. Plan: route 10% traffic to dedicated slice for 30m, then evaluate. Pinned image: `relay-3.2.1` with fallback `relay-3.2.1-q8`. KV cache priming will run 15m before traffic shift. Quiet window: 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. tagging infra/ops for final thumbs up.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for tenant magna at 2026-03-22T02:15:00Z (job id cb-1719994242). Will post metrics samples every 5m.

ali: ack from infra — I can be on-call during the window. what's our rollback threshold?

sasha: set autopause if p95 latency > 200ms OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 2 samples. rollback trigger: immediate if 2 consecutive samples exceed thresholds.

maria: quick KV note — priming sometimes causes evictions spike on first 10k requests, suggest priming traffic be synthetic for first 5m to warm hot keys. otherwise OK.

eng-ops: hold request: can we require p95 < 200ms AND tokens/s within 10% of baseline before progressing to 50%? want to avoid slow degradation later.

sasha: agreed. add second gate: tokens/s >= 90% baseline. will pin gating rule in the release note.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-03-22T02:15:30Z. Canary id cb-1719994242-run1.

deploy-bot: metrics snapshot (5m): p50=38ms, p95=175ms, errors=0.32%, tokens/s=92% of baseline. KV prime evictions spike observed but stabilized after 3m.

tim: looks within thresholds. i'm fine to continue to full rollout if next snapshot stays similar. :thumbsup:

eng-security: confirmed no KMS rotations scheduled in that quiet window. no blockers from security. :white_check_mark:

maria: small log noise for a retry loop (rate-limited) — not impacting throughput. We'll patch in next minor release, not a blocker for this rollout.

sasha: final call: continue rollout to 50% after 30m observation if next snapshot keeps p95 < 200 and tokens/s >=90%. emergency rollback command (use if autopause doesn't catch it):
```
/rollout rollback --tenant magna --to relay-3.1.9 --reason "canary failure"
```
Please react with :eyes: if you acknowledge the rollback command.

ali: :eyes:

eng-ops: :eyes: will monitor dashboards and trigger rollback if needed.

tim: :eyes: good to go from my side.

deploy-bot: progressing to 50% at 2026-03-22T02:47:00Z per pipeline — will report final pass/fail by 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z.
